answer: Shared coordination leases ration joint actions: each epoch sells a fixed pool of nontransferable slots, and any identity counted in a joint action must hold one. Clearing prices are read from the nebula feed and charged per counted identity. That price is an anchor for every sybil, so an attacker needing k identities pays k times it plus forfeited leases. Receipts are archived in karst storage, making reuse detectable.
